args: Frames 2–4, 7, 8 and 10 are good — keep them exactly. Frame 1 must lean far forward with both paws pressed flat on the invisible boulder, like frames 2–4, with the opposite leg forward. Frames 5 and 6: REMOVE the lever stick completely — only the character with both paws closed as if gripping an invisible handle (5 paws high above the head, 6 paws low at the belly, body bent). Frame 9: leaning forward, both front paws raised high at head height lifting an invisible heavy lid, curious happy face. Every frame faces RIGHT.
